title: Guard the contracts Composer and the Reader share
acceptance: Snapshot tests fail on any edit to JEV_COLOR_THEMES, RISE_CURRENT_THEMES, RISE_CURRENT_VISUALS and ATTRACTOR_VISUAL_MANIFEST.
A deliberate edit to each guarded value is seen to fail its test before the guards merge.
Lands before any Reader consolidation change to shared code (A5, B1, B2, B3, C3, D1).

evidence.note: Package A0: the contracts the consolidation adds beside and never edits.
Pins RISE_CURRENT_VISUALS and RISE_CURRENT_LIMITS. Theme ids, RISE_CURRENT_THEMES and ATTRACTOR_VISUAL_MANIFEST were already pinned by rise-current.test.js and attractor-manifest.test.js.

Local mutation run: adding a visual, raising the segment cap, adding a theme, changing classic's palette and widening the intensity maximum each failed its guard; on main's tests the first two passed unnoticed.

activity.summary: Claimed; guards in progress on branch composer-contract-guards.

summary: The nine theme ids, what each theme draws, Composer's three visuals, the Current's size limits and the attractor control's range are pinned as literals; an edit to any of them fails a test.
